import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv("data/sleep_health.csv")

# Data Preprocessing
# Fill NaN values in 'Sleep Disorder' for cleaner plotting
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None', inplace=True)

# Map BMI Category to an ordered categorical type for better visual sorting
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", font_scale=1.1)

# Create the figure and axes
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 8), sharey=True)
fig.suptitle('Sleep Quality vs. Duration by BMI and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# --- Plot 1: Violin plot for Sleep Quality by BMI ---
sns.violinplot(
    ax=axes[0],
    data=df,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    split=True,
    inner='quart',
    palette='viridis',
    linewidth=1.5
)
axes[0].set_title('Sleep Quality Distribution by BMI', fontsize=16)
axes[0].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (Scale 1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='upper left')
axes[0].grid(axis='y', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# --- Plot 2: Scatter plot for Sleep Quality vs. Duration ---
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[1],
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Stress Level',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    palette='magma',
    sizes=(30, 250),
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='black',
    linewidth=0.5
)
axes[1].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Duration', fontsize=16)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (Hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('') # Y-axis is shared
axes[1].grid(axis='both', linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)

# Customize the legend for the scatter plot
handles, labels = scatter.get_legend_handles_labels()
# Separate size and hue legends
size_idx = df['Physical Activity Level'].nunique()
hue_idx = df['Stress Level'].nunique()
# Display only a subset of legend items to avoid clutter
legend1 = axes[1].legend(handles[1:hue_idx+1], labels[1:hue_idx+1], bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0., title='Stress Level')
axes[1].add_artist(legend1)
axes[1].legend(handles[hue_idx+1:], labels[hue_idx+1:], bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.6), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0., title='Physical Activity')

# Adjust layout to prevent overlap
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95]) # Adjust rect for suptitle

# Save the final figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
